;by RST7
;turbo fix by ACi8
ATRFREE EQU 7
ATRSN   EQU 48
ATRRABB EQU #C4
        ORG #4000
        DUP 3
        DEFS 256,-1
        DEFS #600,#81
        DEFS 256,-1
        EDUP
        ORG #5800
        DEFS 768,ATRFREE
        ORG #7000
        DEFS #1000
HEAD    EQU 4
LAST    EQU 0
XPOS    EQU 0
YPOS    EQU 0
RABBIT  EQU 0
FLAG    EQU 0
        REPEAT
        ORG 23672
        REPEAT
        UNTIL0 {$}&2
        DW 2
KEY=.{#5C08}
        IF0 KEY-"q"
YPOS=YPOS-1
        ENDIF
        IF0 KEY-"a"
YPOS=YPOS+1
        ENDIF
        IF0 KEY-"o"
XPOS=XPOS-1&31
        ENDIF
        IF0 KEY-"p"
XPOS=XPOS+1&31
        ENDIF
        IF0 YPOS+1
YPOS=23
        ENDIF
        IF0 YPOS-24
YPOS=0
        ENDIF
        ORG YPOS<5+XPOS+#5800
GAMEOVER=.{$}-ATRSN
        IF0 .{$}-ATRRABB
RABBIT=0
        ENDIF
        DEFB ATRSN
l={LAST+#7000}
        ORG 'l<5+.l+#5800
        DEFB ATRFREE
        ORG HEAD+#7000
        DEFB XPOS,YPOS
HEAD=$&#FFF
        IF0 FLAG
LAST=LAST+2&#FFF
        ELSE
FLAG=FLAG-1
        ENDIF
        IF0 RABBIT
l={HEAD+LAST}
        ORG l<8+.l&#2FF+#5800
        IF0 .{$}-ATRFREE
        DEFB ATRRABB
RABBIT=1
FLAG=4
        ENDIF
        ENDIF
        UNTIL0 GAMEOVER
        DISPLAY "TOTALSCORE=",HEAD-LAST&#FFF/2
